package q

import (
	"log"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func rec(n int) int { return rec(n+1) + 1 }

type T struct{ m map[string]int }

func (t *T) Set(k string) { t.m[k] = 1 }

func FuzzQ(f *testing.F) {
	f.Fuzz(func(t *testing.T, s string) {
		switch s {
		case "hang":
			for {
				time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
			}
		case "so":
			rec(0)
		case "logfatal":
			log.Fatal("boom")
		case "exit0":
			os.Exit(0)
		case "skip":
			t.Skip("not this one")
		case "fatal":
			t.Log("before")
			t.Fatalf("bad value %q at %d", s, 7)
		case "nilmap":
			(&T{}).Set(s)
		case "ok":
		}
	})
}
